subject: Math
prompt:
[Figure 1]

The scatterplot shows the relationship between two variables, $x$ and $y$. A line of best fit for the data is also shown.

For how many of the $10$ data points is the actual $y$-value greater than the $y$-value predicted by the line of best fit?
explanation: Choice C is correct. A data point whose actual $y$-value is greater than the $y$-value predicted by the line of best fit lies above the line. In the scatterplot shown, $6$ of the $10$ data points lie above the line of best fit. Therefore, $6$ data points have an actual $y$-value that is greater than the predicted $y$-value.
